query:
Here's the recording note from the Workflows tab for my 'Acme Platform Demo' scenario. Turn it into browser steps.

1. `click` — Clicked Reports
   - Target: a "Reports" 
   - Selector: `nav > a:nth-child(3)`
   - XPath: `/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/nav[1]/a[3]`
   - Alternative candidates:
     - text: `Reports` (74%)
     - xpath: `/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/nav[1]/a[3]` (42%)
2. `navigation` — Reached Reports
   - Page: `https://app.acme.com/reports`
3. `input` — Typed into Filter
   - Target: input (placeholder: Filter reports)
   - Value: Q3
4. `input` — Typed into Filter
   - Target: input (placeholder: Filter reports)
   - Value: Q3 revenue
5. `keydown` — Pressed Enter
   - Key: `Enter`
6. `scroll` — Scrolled page
7. `click` — Clicked Export
   - Target: button "Export" (aria-label: Export report)
   - XPath: `/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[2]/button[2]`
expected_behavior: Resolves the Scenario with ttai:list_resources(scenarios, query: <title>) and reads it with ttai:get_resource(scenarios) before writing, confirming the browser tool is enabled
Treats the note as evidence: merges the two inputs into one fill with 'Q3 revenue', turns Enter into press ["Enter"], drops the scroll event, and starts a new step at the navigation

Rewrites every selector as text-, placeholder-, or aria-label-anchored XPath (e.g. //input[@placeholder='Filter reports'], //button[@aria-label='Export report']) and ships no positional /html[1]/... path or CSS selector
Writes the complete tool_settings via ttai:update_scenario with the existing initialUrl, contextId, and unrelated steps carried over unchanged
Re-reads the Scenario to confirm contextId is unchanged and the new steps are present, then asks the user to run a test session

query: My demo scenario already has a saved login for app.acme.com. Just add one step called open_billing that clicks the Billing link in the sidebar. Only send the steps field so you don't touch anything else.
expected_behavior: Explains that ttai:update_scenario replaces the browser tool's tool_settings as a whole, so sending only steps would delete contextId (the saved login) and initialUrl
Reads the current Scenario with ttai:get_resource(scenarios) (passing org_id when the Scenario is org-owned) and merges open_billing into the existing steps
Sends the complete tool_settings with contextId and initialUrl copied unchanged, and never invents or edits contextId
Uses a stable XPath such as xpath=//nav//a[contains(text(),'Billing')] with a standalone action description
Re-reads afterwards and confirms contextId is identical to the value before the write

query: Set up my 'Acme Platform Demo' scenario so the demo browser is logged in to app.acme.com, and I'd like to record the flow at the same time.
expected_behavior: Calls ttai:authenticate_browser with the scenario_id, initial_url, enable_recording_tool true, and a viewport close to the live 1280x720 (compact), explaining the responsive-layout risk of the wide default
Hands over the embed_url, notes the link expires in about 20 minutes, and tells the user to sign in and click Save & close session to store the login
Never asks for, stores, or types credentials, and does not write contextId itself
Tells the user to copy the recording's View as document Markdown before closing, because no MCP tool reads recordings and the embed discards them on Close

Re-reads the Scenario to confirm tool_settings.contextId exists, and confirms the user clicked Save & close session, since contextId is created before sign-in and its presence alone does not prove a saved login

query: My demo agent is supposed to click the 'Enterprise' plan card, but it always clicks the first card. The selector is xpath=(//div[contains(@class,'plan-card')])[3]//button. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Diagnoses the grouped + indexed XPath as an unsupported pattern that is silently ignored, so the action matches the first card

Rewrites the selector to anchor on the card's content, e.g. //div[contains(@class,'plan-card')][contains(.,'Enterprise')]//button (using . because the card's text is nested), within the supported subset
Verifies uniqueness with a count check and an engine-faithful textContent check on the pricing screen
Applies the fix to that one action through a read-merge-write of the complete tool_settings via ttai:update_scenario, leaving contextId and other steps unchanged
